brief:
# Executive Pre-Meeting Brief: Team TS3012 (Prior to Final Meeting 'd')

## 1. What Has Been Decided
- **Casing Material & Aesthetics:** The team agreed to produce the remote casing in rubber, featuring a rounded, curved body with high-contrast yellow and black styling (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker C: "can we make yellow rubber? I").
- **Core Feature Set:** The team committed to integrating both an LCD screen and an advanced speech recognition component into the functional design (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker B: "speech recognition component, which was pretty").
- **Navigation Controls:** A scroll-wheel navigation concept was formally voted out in favor of standard tactile push buttons and a dedicated central menu button (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker C: "Let's vote on it. Then we don't have to talk about it any longer").

## 2. What Changed Along the Way
- **Energy Source Evolution:** Speaker C (Industrial Designer) initially strongly championed a kinetic energy generator (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker C: "fav favourite is the kinetic provision"). However, Speaker A (Project Manager) pushed back, arguing that remote controls do not move constantly enough like wristwatches to generate sufficient charge (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker A: "watches can go on kinetic energy because they move all the time"), prompting a shift back to battery power.
- **Form Factor Refinements:** Early corporate trend ideas were narrowed down from exotic shapes into an ergonomic handheld design with no sharp edges.

## 3. Open Actions and Who Owns Them
- **Speaker B (Nick Broer / UI Designer) & Speaker C (Xavier Juergens / Industrial Designer):** Action item to build and finish the physical prototype and color layouts in time for presentation at the final meeting (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker A: "You doodle a doodle us a nice nice design for for the next meeting").
- **Speaker A (Mark / Project Manager):** Action item to obtain and evaluate the official financial costing figures, which were unavailable during detailed design (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker A: "too bad we don't have the finance. We could've").
- **Speaker D (Dirk Meinfeld / Marketing Expert):** Action item to finalize user preference data and marketing evaluation forms.

## 4. Disagreements Still Open
- **Power Feasibility for LCD Display:** Residual disagreement regarding whether alternative energy could support advanced features remains unresolved heading into final review (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker A: "if we were choose the the L_C_D_ option, would it give enough energy").
- **Removable Case Option:** Speaker D questioned whether a removable cover should be included for user customization, which was deferred without full team consensus (Meeting TS3012c, Speaker D: "we don't uh use our reco uh we uh removable cover").
- **Budget Uncertainty:** All technical components (LCD, speech chip, rubber casing) were selected without verified price limits, leaving the design vulnerable to mandatory cuts once costings are unveiled in Meeting 'd'.
